name: tiny-fish
description: A compact neo-brutalist switch with a 5px-radius track, hard offset shadow, and a matching square knob.
purpose: Toggles a binary setting with the Uiverse hard-edge switch silhouette instead of a pill thumb.
bestFor: settings rows that need a stamped, offset-shadow control
playful forms that stay on semantic tokens
avoidFor: dense toolbars that need a quiet iOS-style pill
